aeo.q: What is the AI Ops Sprint?
aeo.a: The AI Ops Sprint is a fixed, 10-business-day engagement that automates one workflow or ships one AI copilot inside your existing tools. It's built for ops teams buried in manual steps who need a quick, provable win — you get a working integration, lightweight documentation and a handover session before committing to anything larger.

aeo.q: How long does the AI Ops Sprint take?
aeo.a: Ten business days, start to finish. Days 1–2 cover kickoff, requirements and tool access; days 3–6 build and connect the automation or copilot; days 7–8 are user testing and refinements with your team; days 9–10 deploy to production with documentation, a handover session and go-live.

aeo.q: What's included in the AI Ops Sprint?
aeo.a: You get one workflow automated or one AI copilot shipped, scoped to complexity, deployed to your tools and ready to use. It includes lightweight documentation, a handover session and 30 days of bug-fix support. Multiple workflows, custom UI development and data migration sit outside the sprint and are scoped separately.

aeo.q: How much does the AI Ops Sprint cost?
aeo.a: Pricing is fixed and agreed before any work begins: {{price}}. There are no hourly rates or surprises — scope is locked at kickoff. Invoices are issued in EUR or GBP on 50% upfront, 50% on completion terms, and most clients recover the cost within two to four weeks through the hours saved on manual tasks.

howWeBuild.title: How we build your MVP

stages.title: Define the product

stages.title: Build, test and check
stages.body: We build in short cycles you can see, connecting real authentication, data storage and analytics — not mockups. Data handling, retention and access controls are reviewed at set compliance checkpoints as we go, so nothing needs retrofitting later.

stages.title: Deploy and hand over
stages.body: We deploy to production and hand you everything: the running product, the source code and IP, technical documentation, and data-retention and processing notes your DPO can act on. You leave with a product you can demo, ship and raise on.

items.answer: Use Request training dates. Tell us which tracks you want, the format that suits your team, and two or three preferred dates. We reply with the slots we can confirm, usually within two working days.

items.question: Can we choose our own dates?
items.answer: Yes. The request form takes two or three preferred dates plus an optional note on your wider timeframe. We hold the closest match we can staff and confirm it by email before anything is booked.

items.question: Which topics do you cover?
items.answer: Four tracks: AI, software development, automation and workflows, and AI governance and compliance. Each track is shaped around your real work, so we drop or deepen individual topics to fit the team.

items.question: How do we become a training partner?
items.answer: Use Become a training partner. Tell us what you deliver, your accreditations and which tracks you can co-deliver. We review every application and reply either way.

trainingPage.finalText: Tell us your tools, your team and what you want them to be able to do. We come back with a training plan and a quote, with no obligation.

faq.heading: AI automation, answered
faq.intro: Workflow automation connects the tools your team already uses so repetitive steps run without manual handling, with a full audit trail. Here is how we approach it for UK and EU SMEs.

items.q: What is workflow automation for SMEs?
items.a: Workflow automation connects the tools you already use, such as your CRM, helpdesk, spreadsheets and email, so repetitive steps run without manual handling. For SMEs it typically removes data re-entry, chasing and status updates, freeing hours of admin time while keeping a full audit trail.

items.q: How long does it take to automate a workflow?
items.a: A single workflow ships in about 10 business days through the AI Ops Sprint. Production-grade automation across three to five tools takes four to six weeks through the Automation Build. Both are fixed-scope and agreed before any work starts.

We work with the tools most UK and EU SMEs already run, including HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Notion, Zendesk, Xero and Zapier or Make. If your stack is not listed, we scope the integration on a short call.

items.q: Is AI automation GDPR and EU AI Act ready?
items.a: Yes. Every build is GDPR-by-design with least-privilege access, clear data-retention notes, and an audit trail from day one. Work is scoped to stay clear of prohibited EU AI Act use cases.
